title: Tyldesley and Ostrander Share Tips at Meet The Artist
paragraphs: Gallery artists, Weedie Tyldesley and Elaine Felos Ostrander, shared their skills during our free summer series ‘Meet The Artist’ on Saturday, August 12
Elaine Felos Ostrander demonstrating at Meet The Artist, ©Guild of Harwich Artists

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists hosts a series of free Meet The Artist demonstrations throughout the summer on Saturdays, from 2 pm – 4 pm. Gallery artists share their tips and techniques in a variety of mediums including, pastel, watercolor, acrylic, oil, and mixed media; discuss painting en plein air; and talk materials and supplies. Read more about our Meet The Artist series.
Elaine Felos Ostrander demonstrating at Meet The Artist, ©Guild of Harwich Artists
Elaine Felos Ostrander demonstrating at Meet The Artist, ©Guild of Harwich Artists

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week, including extended hours for Summer Port Nights. The Art Gallery exhibits original artwork by 24 local artists. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce.

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists hosts a series of free Meet The Artist demonstrations throughout the summer on Saturdays, from 2 pm – 4 pm. Gallery artists share their tips and techniques in a variety of mediums including, pastel, watercolor, acrylic, oil, and mixed media; discuss painting en plein air; and talk materials and supplies. Read more about our Meet The Artist series.

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week, including extended hours for Summer Port Nights. The Art Gallery exhibits original artwork by 24 local artists. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce.
